sanskrit_verse:
जालसूर्यमरीचिस्थं त्रसरेणू रजः स्मृतम ।
ते ऽष्टौ लिक्षातु तास्तिस्रो राजसर्षप उच्यते ॥ १.३६२
transliteration: jālasūryamarīcisthaṃ trasareṇū rajaḥ smṛtam | te 'ṣṭau likṣā tu tās tisro rājasarṣapa ucyate || 1.362
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is seen as dust motes in a sunbeam filtered through a net is termed 'trasareṇu'. Eight of these constitute one 'likṣā', and three of those likṣās together form one 'rājasarṣapa'.
